title: Payment Terms Holdback on Final Rebate Checks (Contract Pricing Agreement)
content:
## Payment terms holdback — Contract Pricing Agreement final rebate check

The terms holdback follows the late payment finance charges assessed on the customer's Commercial Credit Account less than 12 whole months before the handling date, each counted by the charge's ledger date. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

1. 3 or more such charges hold back 3 percent of the unpaid rebate balance.
2. At least one and fewer than 3 hold back 1.5 percent of it.
3. None hold back no terms holdback.

The amount is held back from the unpaid rebate balance before the final check's floor at 0.00, its rounding to the cent and its minimum payout test are applied; what is held back stays in the rebate balance.

Hypothetical example: two finance charges in the window against an unpaid balance of 2000.00 hold back 30.00; a third charge in the window raises the holdback to 60.00.
